name: GST for WooCommerce – GST Invoice, CGST SGST IGST Tax Rates, GSTR-1 Reports & HSN
author: raintech357

raintech.display_name: Best Restaurant Billing Software in India

sections.description:
GST India for WooCommerce is a complete GST (Goods and Services Tax) solution for online stores in India. It creates the right WooCommerce tax rates, adds a validated GSTIN field at checkout, issues compliant GST tax invoices and credit notes with financial-year numbering, and gives your Chartered Accountant (CA) ready-to-use GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B working data.

Everything lives in one new GST India menu in your WordPress dashboard: Dashboard, Invoices, Reports, Settings and Tools.

Looking for a WooCommerce GST plugin that handles GST 2.0 slabs (0%, 5%, 18%, 40%), intra-state CGST + SGST, inter-state IGST, UTGST for Union Territories, B2B GSTIN invoices and GSTR-1 export? This plugin does all of it.

Support

Need help? Contact the Raintech support team: https://raintech.pages.dev/contact

Why store owners choose this GST plugin

  • One setup screen. Choose your state, GSTIN and slabs, and the plugin builds every tax class and rate for you.
  • Invoice numbers that never duplicate, never skip, and reset each financial year.
  • One-click data pack for your CA with invoices, credit notes, line items and GSTR-1 tables.
  • A GST health check that tells you what to fix before you file.

GST tax rates for WooCommerce

  • Creates WooCommerce tax classes and rates for the slabs you select, using WooCommerce’s own tax API (no duplicate rows on re-sync).
  • GST 2.0 slabs (live since 22 September 2025): 0%, 5%, 18% and 40%.
  • Special rates: 0.25%, 1.5% and 3%. Legacy 12% and 28% slabs available for old-period orders.
  • Intra-state sales get CGST + SGST. Inter-state sales get IGST.
  • Union Territories without a legislature (Andaman and Nicobar, Chandigarh, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, Lakshadweep, Ladakh) get UTGST instead of SGST.
  • The 0% slab uses WooCommerce’s built-in Zero rate class, so it never overrides your Standard rate.
  • One-click “sync missing rates” and automatic fix of old wrong state codes (UT, TG, OR) from version 1.x.

GSTIN validation and B2B checkout

  • Real GSTIN checksum validation (mod-36), not just a format check, for your store GSTIN and for buyers.
  • Optional buyer GSTIN field at checkout, works with the classic checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout block.
  • PAN and entity type detected from the GSTIN. Live “Valid GSTIN / Invalid GSTIN” feedback in the admin.
  • Orders with a valid buyer GSTIN are marked B2B automatically.

Place of supply

  • Place of supply follows the delivery address according to your WooCommerce tax setting.
  • Automatic classification into B2B, B2C Large (inter-state above Rs 2.5 lakh), B2C Small and Export.
  • Correct state codes for WooCommerce, including Uttarakhand (UK), Telangana (TS), Odisha (OD) and Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu (DH).

GST tax invoice and credit note numbering

  • Gap-free, duplicate-free invoice numbers, safe even when many orders arrive at the same time.
  • Financial-year reset (April to March) with prefix tokens such as {FY}, {FY2}, {YYYY}, {YY} and {MM}.
  • GST Rule 46 checks: maximum 16 characters, only letters, digits, “-” and “/”.
  • Separate credit note series. Credit notes are built from WooCommerce refunds, so a partial refund creates a credit note for only the refunded items and tax.
  • Choose the order status that triggers the invoice number, and optionally issue a credit note automatically on refund.
  • Edit a number or date inline, with warnings for duplicates and invalid format.

Printable GST invoices

  • Print or save as PDF straight from the browser. No heavy PDF library, no server load.
  • Three templates (Classic, Modern, Minimal), accent colour, logo, signature, bank details and terms.
  • Shows HSN/SAC, rate, taxable value, CGST, SGST/UTGST, IGST, round off and total in Indian number format with amount in words (crore and lakh).
  • Customers can download their tax invoice from My Account, the order list and order emails.
  • Bulk print up to 200 invoices or credit notes at once.

HSN and SAC codes

  • HSN/SAC field on every product and every variation.
  • Default HSN per product category, used when a product has none.
  • HSN column in the product list, bulk edit and a bulk assign tool for tax class and HSN.
  • HSN-wise summary on the invoice and in GSTR-1.

Invoices screen

  • Fast React-powered screen to find, number, edit, print and export documents.
  • Filter by order, invoice or credit note date, order status and invoiced or not invoiced.
  • Search by invoice number, credit note number or buyer GSTIN.
  • Bulk generate invoice numbers and credit notes, with options to use the order date and skip existing numbers.
  • Export the filtered list to CSV.

GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B reports

  • GSTR-1 working tables: B2B (4), B2C Large (5), Exports (6), B2C Small (7), Credit and debit notes registered and unregistered (9B), HSN summary (12) and Documents issued (13).
  • GSTR-3B style totals: taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST and net tax payable after credit notes.
  • Date presets for this month, last month and the financial year.
  • CSV formula-injection protection on every export.

Download all data for your CA

One click on GST India > Reports > Download all (ZIP) gives your accountant a ready data pack:
* register.csv – every invoice with customer, GSTIN, place of supply, taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST and total.
* cn_register.csv – every credit note with the invoice it was issued against.
* items.csv – line-level detail of invoices and credit notes with HSN, rate and tax split.
* GSTR-1 working tables as separate CSV files.
* A README with the period and document counts.

Dashboard and GST health check

  • Dashboard with sales, tax collected, B2B vs B2C split, tax by rate and a monthly net-tax chart for the financial year.
  • Health score that checks your GSTIN, state, WooCommerce tax settings, missing rates, products without HSN, numbering format, duplicate invoice numbers, orders without an invoice number and checkout GSTIN field.
  • One-click fixes for WooCommerce tax settings and missing rates.

Tools

  • Bulk assign HSN codes and tax classes.
  • Sync tax rates, export and import plugin settings as JSON (counters are never imported).
  • Reset invoice numbers for chosen orders (with confirmation).
  • System information for support.

Modern admin design

A custom, clean admin interface with its own design system, scoped so it never clashes with other plugins. The Invoices screen and dashboard chart are built with React using WordPress scripts.

Compatibility

  • WooCommerce 8.0 and newer, tested with WooCommerce 11.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) compatible.
  • Cart and Checkout blocks compatible.
  • PHP 7.4 and newer.

Important notice

GSTR files are working papers to help your CA. Always reconcile with your books before filing returns. This plugin does not file returns on the GST portal.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Open GST India > Settings and enter your business name, state and GSTIN.
  4. In the Tax tab choose your slabs and click Sync tax rates.
  5. Open GST India > Dashboard and clear any items in the health check.
  6. Set your invoice prefix and numbering in the Numbering tab.

Building the admin app from source (developers)

The React source is in src/. The compiled files are already included in build/.
1. Run npm install.
2. Run npm run build (or npm start while developing).
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with GST 2.0?

Yes. The 0%, 5%, 18% and 40% slabs are the defaults. Legacy 12% and 28% slabs stay available for old orders.

Does it charge CGST and SGST or IGST automatically?

Yes. Rates are created per state. A sale inside your state gets CGST + SGST (or UTGST for eligible Union Territories). A sale to another state gets IGST.

Can customers enter a GSTIN at checkout?

Yes. An optional GSTIN field is added to classic and block checkout and validated with the official checksum.

How do I send my accountant the GST data?

Go to GST India > Reports, pick the period and click Download all (ZIP). It includes the invoice register, credit note register, line items and GSTR-1 tables.

Can I make a PDF invoice?

Open the invoice and choose Print, then Save as PDF in your browser. This keeps the plugin light and works on any host.

Does it file GST returns?

No. It prepares clean working data for GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B. Your CA files on the GST portal.

Will my existing invoice numbers change?

No. Existing numbers are kept. Version 2 syncs old invoices once with a single click.

Is it HPOS compatible?

Yes.

Does uninstalling delete my data?

Only if you enable “Delete data on uninstall”. Invoice number counters are kept to protect your series.

Where can I get help?

Contact support at https://raintech.pages.dev/contact
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Complete redesign with a custom admin design system.
  • New React-based Invoices screen and dashboard chart.
  • New: financial-year invoice numbering with Rule 46 checks and duplicate protection.
  • New: credit notes from WooCommerce refunds.
  • New: GSTIN checksum validation and block checkout field.
  • New: place of supply, B2B / B2CL / B2CS / export classification.
  • New: GSTR-1 tables, GSTR-3B totals and one-click CA data pack (invoice register, credit note register, line items).
  • New: GST health check with one-click fixes.
  • New: HSN/SAC on variations and category defaults.
  • New: three invoice templates, settings export and import.
  • Fixed: wrong state codes (UT, TG, OR) and 0% slab landing in the Standard tax class.
  • Changed: invoices are Print / Save as PDF. The old ZIP-of-PDF feature was removed.
